message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, cult‑favorite, and contemporary horror films across several sub‑genres. Pick whatever feels right for your mood!

| # | Title | Year | Sub‑genre / Notable Twist |
|---|-------|------|---------------------------|
| 1 | **Psycho** | 1960 | Psychological thriller – iconic shower scene, unreliable narrator. |
| 2 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Haunted hotel, supernatural isolation, Jack Nicholson’s descent into madness. |
| 3 | **Halloween** | 1978 | Slasher origin story, Michael Myers’ silent menace. |
| 4 | **The Exorcist** | 1973 | Demonic possession, chilling realism, “It’s a…” line. |
| 5 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Family trauma meets cosmic horror; intense dread, unsettling imagery. |
| 6 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Social satire + psychological horror; twist on “the other side.” |
| 7 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Silence as survival; tense family dynamics, unique sound design. |
| 8 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Daylight horror, folk cult rituals, unsettling atmosphere. |
| 9 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Psychological horror, mother‑child relationship, metaphorical monster. |
|10 | **It Follows** | 2014 | Viral curse, relentless stalker, retro synth soundtrack. |
|11 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Japanese‑American remake, cursed videotape, slow‑burn dread. |
|12 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Found‑footage realism, subtle creepiness, low‑budget charm. |
|13 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | Paranormal investigators, real‑life inspiration, atmospheric scares. |
|14 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Meta‑horror, subverts tropes, twist on “cabin horror.” |
|15 | **Suspiria (2018)** | 2018 | Reimagined remake, surreal visuals, haunting score. |

Feel free to let me know if you’d like recommendations tailored to a particular era, sub‑genre, or if you’re looking for something more obscure!
